name: Access Control
summary:
Product Manager at HotWax Commerce.
Retailer (enthusiastic, cares about improvements and new features).
A cluster of updates related to system permissions.

        *   Features/Enhancements: Problem, Solution, Impact.
        *   Bug Fixes: "Fixed a bug if [Condition], [Symptom]."
        *   Simpler is better.
        *   Active voice.
        *   Granular but concise (3-4 sentences for features, 1 sentence for bugs).
        *   Professional, utility-focused tone.
        *   *No* AI slop (enhanced, streamlined, seamless, robust).
        *   *No* exclamation points.
        *   *No* dev-time bugs for new features.
        *   Standalone bug fixes must start with "Fixed a bug...".

    *   *Fulfillment #1626:* Moved "Ship Now" and "Unpack" controls from product-store settings to security permissions (security groups).
    *   *Fulfillment #1599:* Fixed incorrect permissions on multiple pages. (True bug fix).
    *   *Transfers #245/246 & OMS #817:* Discrepancies and Bulk Upload screens were unreachable because permission IDs didn't exist in the backend or had mismatched env variables. Fixed by adding/renaming permissions. (True bug
